name: X-ONU-SFPP-Dashboard
description: A lightweight monitoring and alerting dashboard for EXEN X-ONU-SFPP and compatible ONTs running 8311 community firmware. Core monitoring uses the 8311 JSON metrics endpoint to provide live and historical optical levels, temperatures, PLOAM state, connectivity, and profile-aware optical health without requiring SSH. Optional SSH telemetry adds live XGS-PON traffic rates, byte counters, FEC/BIP/HEC/MIC statistics, active alarms, ONT system information, and optical module details. Server-side alert monitoring provides configurable thresholds, severities, debounce behavior, counter-delta detection, and cooldowns. Alerts are stored in SQLite and continue to be evaluated even when the dashboard is not open. Notifications are supported through Discord, ntfy, Gotify, Pushover, and Generic Webhook. Telemetry and alert-history retention are configurable from the dashboard. Recent alerts are shown directly on the main dashboard, with a dedicated paginated Alert History view for retained events. The dashboard also supports light, dark, and system themes. The Unraid host must have network access to the ONT management IP. SSH access is optional and is required only for advanced telemetry.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Persistent storage for the SQLite metrics database.

ports.name: WebUI
ports.description: Host port used to access the X-ONU-SFPP Dashboard.

variables.name: ONT Metrics URL
variables.description: URL of the 8311 JSON metrics endpoint.

variables.name: Polling Interval
variables.description: Number of seconds between core ONT metric requests.

variables.name: Enable Advanced SSH Telemetry
variables.description: Enable optional SSH-based advanced telemetry. Core monitoring works without SSH.

variables.name: SSH Host
variables.description: Management IP or hostname of the ONT used for advanced SSH telemetry.

variables.name: SSH Port
variables.description: SSH port used for advanced telemetry.

variables.name: SSH Username
variables.description: SSH username used for advanced telemetry.

variables.name: SSH Password
variables.description: SSH password used for advanced telemetry. The value is passed to the container as a Docker environment variable and can be inspected by users with Docker or Unraid host access.

variables.name: SSH Polling Interval
variables.description: Number of seconds between advanced SSH telemetry collection cycles.

variables.name: SSH Command Timeout
variables.description: Maximum time in seconds allowed for advanced telemetry commands.

variables.name: Request Timeout
variables.description: Timeout in seconds when requesting metrics from the ONT.

variables.name: Data Directory
variables.description: Container directory used for persistent dashboard data. Normally this should remain /data.
